=========================================================

Problem Statement
-----------------

In Week 2, DVC was used to version datasets and model artifacts.

DVC answers an important question:

"Which version of the dataset was used for model training?"

However, DVC does not solve another important production problem:

"How can we guarantee that exactly the same feature engineering logic is used during both model training and model inference?"

If feature engineering is implemented separately for training and inference, it can introduce differences in the feature values seen by the model. This problem is known as Training-Serving Skew.

To eliminate this issue, Feast Feature Store was integrated into the IRIS Machine Learning Pipeline.

Feast provides a centralized feature repository that allows both Offline Training and Online Inference to use the same feature definitions.

Implementation Steps
--------------------

STEP 1 : Created Week 3 Branch
------------------------------

Command

git checkout -b week_3

Purpose

Create a separate branch for Week 3 implementation without affecting previous assignments.

=========================================================

STEP 2 : Installed Feast
------------------------

Command

pip install feast

Purpose

Install Feast Feature Store.

=========================================================

STEP 3 : Initialize Feast Repository
------------------------------------

Command

feast init feature_repo

Purpose

Creates the Feast Repository including

• feature_store.yaml

• Registry

• SQLite Online Store

• Repository Structure

=========================================================

STEP 4 : Prepare Feast Dataset
------------------------------

Created File

prepare_feast_data.py

Purpose

• Load IRIS Dataset

• Create sample_id

• Add event_timestamp

• Convert dataset into Parquet format

Output

iris_features.parquet

Command

python prepare_feast_data.py

=========================================================

STEP 5 : Define Feast Objects
-----------------------------

Created File

feature_definitions.py

Defined

Entity

sample_id

Data Source

iris_features.parquet

Feature View

• Sepal Length

• Sepal Width

• Petal Length

• Petal Width

Purpose

Create reusable feature definitions for both training and inference.

=========================================================

STEP 6 : Register Feature Definitions
-------------------------------------

Command

cd feature_repo/feature_repo

feast apply

Purpose

Registers

• Entity

• Data Source

• Feature View

inside Feast Registry.

=========================================================

STEP 7 : Materialize Features
-----------------------------

Command

feast materialize 2024-01-01T00:00:00 2025-01-01T00:00:00

Purpose

Copies feature values from the Offline Store into the SQLite Online Store.

These features are now available for online inference.

=========================================================

STEP 8 : Train Model using Offline Store
----------------------------------------

Created File

train_feast.py

Important Feast API

store.get_historical_features()

Purpose

Retrieve historical features from Feast Offline Store.

Machine Learning Algorithm

RandomForestClassifier

Training Accuracy

1.0

Command

cd ../..

python train_feast.py

Output

Training Accuracy : 1.0

Model saved as

iris_model.pkl

=========================================================

STEP 9 : Online Prediction
--------------------------

Created File

predict_feast.py

Important Feast API

store.get_online_features()

Purpose

Retrieve features from Feast Online Store and perform prediction.

Command

python predict_feast.py

Prediction

Setosa

=========================================================

STEP 10 : Verify Training-Serving Consistency
---------------------------------------------

Compared

Prediction using Feast Features

vs

Prediction using Raw Dataset

Output

Prediction using Feast Features

Setosa

Prediction using Raw Data

Setosa

Predictions Match

True

Conclusion

The same feature values are used during training and inference.

Therefore,

Training-Serving Skew has been eliminated.
